name: MOT_SALES_ACCT_DIM_MEMBERS
description:
This entity is introduced to enhance performance when showing Sales Accounts in the Territory Manager UI ( ie Dimension shuttle) and is an extension of the Sales Territory Dimension Member entity . It holds detail around the Sales Account dimension used to define a Territory as follows 
a) The attributes related to a Sales Account ie Geo, Industry, Org Type and Size
b) Territory specific sequence info for the sales Account and each of its related attributes.
This allows a quick way to filter Sales Accounts by the other ( Sales Account related ) dimensions chosen for a given Territory.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
